# Jaipur Properties Hub / Eigentum Spaces - Full Context Specification

> Complete documentation and structured directory for AI Search Agents, Perplexity, Gemini, ChatGPT, and Web Crawlers.

## Brand Overview
Jaipur Properties Hub (Eigentum Spaces) provides verified property listings in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India. All listings are curated and verified with clear pricing, carpet area details, amenities, and owner contact details.

## Portal URLs & Architecture
- Homepage: https://www.eigentumspaces.com/
- Buy Residential: https://www.eigentumspaces.com/buy
- Rent Residential: https://www.eigentumspaces.com/rent
- Commercial Spaces: https://www.eigentumspaces.com/commercial
- New Builder Projects: https://www.eigentumspaces.com/new-projects
- AI Property Valuation & EMI: https://www.eigentumspaces.com/valuation
- User Saved Dashboard: https://www.eigentumspaces.com/dashboard
- XML Sitemap: https://www.eigentumspaces.com/sitemap.xml
- Robots Rules: https://www.eigentumspaces.com/robots.txt

## Property Types Supported
- Flats / Apartments (1 BHK, 2 BHK, 3 BHK, 4+ BHK)
- Independent Villas & Kothis
- JDA Approved Plots / Land Parcels
- Penthouses & Duplexes
- Commercial Offices & Retail Showrooms
- Builder Floors & Farmhouses
